summary: MOOD for DESIGN — Moodboard Editor P0 VISUAL+INTERACTION refactor frontend smoke. Logged in as designer@moodfordesign.com, opened TEST_F1_UI_lux moodboard. 13/15 UI tests GREEN. All 8 expected blocks render on page 1 (block-image x2, block-text x4, block-palette, block-note) inside [data-testid="moodboard-canvas"]. Real photo loads (Unsplash marble texture, NOT placeholder). Editor chrome intact: brand-mark, action-toolbar, library-panel, pages-filmstrip, right-tabs, present-btn, add-page-btn, status-saved — all present. Selection ring renders correctly as premium teal with ring-offset: computed box-shadow is `rgb(10,10,11) 0 0 0 2px, rgb(38,245,201) 0 0 0 4px` (BG offset + teal accent — exactly the F.2 spec). Drag is fluid: 30-step 80px drag over ~3s commits the new position with dx=60 final delta, no jitter observed, autosave indicator transitions to status-saved. Layers panel mounts with 8 layer-row-* entries; dragging row[0] onto row[2] correctly shows [data-testid="layer-drop-indicator-below"] glowing hairline. PagesFilmstrip shows 17 page cards (page 1 has 8 blocks, page 2 has 2 blocks — confirmed page-switch swap). SkeletonPicker opens via add-page-btn. PresentationMode opens via present-btn (cinematic fullscreen). Inspector tab shows full editorial controls inline: URL field, fit mode (Distorci), 3x3 focal grid, zoom 255%, brightness/contrast/saturation. Two MINOR issues: (a) resize handle div has no data-testid='resize-handle' attribute (the div IS rendered with teal glow `shadow-[0_0_8px_var(--bp-primary)]` at MoodboardEditor.jsx:779-780 — purely a missing testid for automation); (b) ImageQuickAdjust modal is only mounted inside ImageUploader.onUploaded path (line 1124) — pasting a URL via the right-inspector 'URL Immagine' InspectorInput does NOT open the modal as the test request implies. Modal works for actual file-upload via the dropzone (path validated by code review, not exercised end-to-end because file dialog can't be automated reliably). No backend regressions observed; GET /api/moodboards/{id} returned full board with pages+elements (single transient 503 on initial cold-load that auto-recovered on retry).

minor.issue: Transient 503 observed once on cold load (Supabase/edge cold start). Self-recovered on retry within 2s. Worth confirming retry policy on frontend api client; right now the editor sometimes lands on an empty canvas if the very first call 503s.

ui_bugs.issue: Visual resize handle is rendered (teal 12x12 with 8px glow shadow) but has no data-testid='resize-handle' attribute. Spec calls it out as a testable element. Add data-testid='resize-handle' on the absolute-positioned div at MoodboardEditor.jsx:779-780.

ui_bugs.component: MoodboardEditor → ImageQuickAdjust modal trigger via URL inspector
ui_bugs.issue: setQuickAdjust({src:url}) is only called from ImageUploader.onUploaded (file-upload path). Setting/pasting the URL via the right-inspector 'URL Immagine' field does not open the ImageQuickAdjust modal. Review request states the modal should also open on URL-set. If intentional (URL is a power-user shortcut), update the spec; otherwise wire a debounced setQuickAdjust on InspectorInput onCommit for c.src.
ui_bugs.selector: MoodboardEditor.jsx:1145 (InspectorInput for imageUrl) vs ImageQuickAdjust mount at line 1126

action_items: Add data-testid="resize-handle" attribute to the resize-handle div in MoodboardEditor.jsx (line 779-780) so automation can target it.

Decide: should pasting an image URL in the inspector also open ImageQuickAdjust? If yes, also call setQuickAdjust({src:url}) from the URL InspectorInput onCommit. If no, update spec to clarify the modal is upload-only.
Optional: add small client-side retry/back-off on GET /api/moodboards/{id} to handle transient 503 cold-starts without leaving the user on an empty canvas.
critical_code_review_comments: MoodboardEditor.jsx is now 1223 lines — well above the 700-line guidance. Hot candidates to split: (a) the drag/resize state machine and rAF mousemove handler into a hook useDragResize(); (b) the entire block-inspector renderer (image/text/palette/etc.) into per-type files like inspectors/ImageBlockInspector.jsx; (c) the modal-mount block (ImageQuickAdjust + SkeletonPicker + TemplatePicker + Presentation) into a separate <EditorModals/> component. Will dramatically ease future iteration and reduce re-render scope.
Resize handle currently lacks data-testid AND aria-label. Add both for testability and accessibility (e.g., aria-label='Ridimensiona blocco').

ImageQuickAdjust modal is mounted INSIDE the per-block inspector renderer (image case). This means a stray re-mount/unmount whenever the user reselects another block. Lift the modal up to the editor root and pass the current block via state so it persists when the user accidentally clicks a different block during the adjust flow.

rAF throttling: confirm the mousemove handler cancels any pending rAF on mouseup, otherwise a stale frame can commit a slightly-stale position after the up event (race). Quick fix: ref.current = null in onMouseUp.

Selection ring uses inline box-shadow with two stacked rings — works perfectly in DOM but the second 4px ring exceeds the element rect; ensure parent containers don't have overflow:hidden clipping the glow.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Editor canvas children use data-testid pattern `block-{type}` (block-image, block-text, block-palette, block-note) — NOT 'canvas-block-*'. Resize handle has no testid yet (see action item). ImageQuickAdjust modal does NOT auto-open on URL paste — only on actual file upload via ImageUploader dropzone. Layer rows use 'layer-row-{index_or_id}', drop indicators 'layer-drop-indicator-above' and '-below'. Page cards: 'page-card-{n}' (17 pages on the test board). Italian locale is active by default for this user; 'Adjust' button label is 'Regola' / 'Applica' / 'Salta'.
rca of the issue: Two items above are not user-facing bugs but spec-vs-impl mismatches: (1) the visual resize handle is fully implemented (teal + 8px glow per spec) but missing the data-testid attribute, so spec-driven automation can't locate it; one-line fix in MoodboardEditor.jsx:779. (2) ImageQuickAdjust modal trigger is wired exclusively to ImageUploader.onUploaded (line 1124) — pasting a URL into the inspector InspectorInput at line 1145 calls onChange on content.src but never setQuickAdjust. To satisfy the F.2 spec verbatim, mirror the setQuickAdjust call from the URL input's onCommit (debounced, only when URL changed and is non-empty).
